composition: Production navigation client with generated worldwide content; nominal 50ms frontend command pulses; normal core simulation and publisher.

before_fix.failure: Faster simulation ticks consumed a frontend pulse then reset NavigationProgress on ClientDirected(None), preventing progress through the known void.

fix: Preserve navigation progress on a client-directed tick with no new pulse; no travel budget is reused. Explicit intent/authority lifecycle resets remain unchanged.
limitations: Live run observes canonical cell changes and server endpoint; intermediate wire publication validity is covered by the existing synthetic session-capture fixture.
Diagnostic route geometry sampled at approximately 0.2m has 58 outside-cell samples; that is not an instrumented count of actual runtime samples.
Restore uses ACE teleloc with <0.05m tolerance, not bit-identical height.
